leadText: The following is a list of chapters from the Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu is a Famous Detective manga. Two volumes were released under the Tentōmusi Comics Special label from 2008 to 2009 and two volumes were released under the label from 2013 to 2015. Altogether, the four compiled volumes contain 65 regular chapters and one bonus chapter.
plainText:
The following is a list of chapters from the Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu is a Famous Detective manga. Two volumes were released under the Tentōmusi Comics Special label from 2008 to 2009 and two volumes were released under the label from 2013 to 2015. Altogether, the four compiled volumes contain 65 regular chapters and one bonus chapter.

==Volume 1 (Tentōmusi Comics Special)==
The first volume under the Tentōmusi Comics Special label contains six regular chapters and one bonus chapter.

 

==Volume 2 (Tentōmusi Comics Special)==
The second volume under the Tentōmusi Comics Special label contains seven regular chapters.

 

==Volume 1 (Big Korotan)==
The first volume under the label contains 21 regular chapters.

 

==Volume 2 (Big Korotan)==
The second volume under the label contains 31 regular chapters.
